SCIE 001.title: Science One
SCIE 001.description: An innovative first-year multi-disciplinary course incorporating biology, chemistry, mathematics, and physics with a strong focus on the connections between these traditional disciplines. Students with credit for SCIE_V 001 will be deemed to have satisfied all BIOL_V 112, BIOL_V 121, BIOL_V 180, CHEM_V 121, CHEM_V 123, MATH_V 100, MATH_V 101, PHYS_V 117, PHYS_V 118, PHYS_V 119, and PHYS_V 129 requirements. See the Science One website (www.scienceone.ubc.ca) for further information and the application process for admission to SCIE_V 001.
SCIE 001.prerequisiteText: All of: CALC 12, ENGL 12, and Pre-calculus 12; two of: CHEM 12, PHYS 12, High School Biology (either BIOL 11 or BIOL 12)

SCIE 010.title: Science One A
SCIE 010.description: Block registration marker for the biology, chemistry, mathematics and physics components of the Science One program. Restricted to students in the Science One program.
SCIE 010.prerequisiteText: Either (a) BIOL 11 or (b) BIOL 12; and all of CHEM 12, CALC 12, PHYS 12, ENGL 12. and Principles of Mathematics 12 or Pre-calculus 12

SCIE 100.title: First-Year Focus Seminar
SCIE 100.description: Seminar for First-Year Focus option focused on discipline-specific learning strategies for academic success and community and scholarly engagement. This course is restricted to first-year students in the First-Year Focus option. Pass/Fail. .

SCIE 104.title: Pre-Calculus Mathematics
SCIE 104.description: Algebra, functions and graphing, expone ntial and logarithmic functions, trigonometry. Restricted to students enrolled in the Indigenous STEM Bridging Pathway.

SCIE 113.title: First-Year Seminar in Science
SCIE 113.description: Small-group experience where students study science in society, scientific process, and how to communicate scientific concepts. Enrolment limited to students in the B.Sc. program in Science. .

SCIE 300.title: Communicating Science
SCIE 300.description: Effective communication and presentation skills in science.

children.raw: 3rd or 4th year standing in Combined Major in Science

SCIE 300.corequisiteText: One of BIOL_V 300, STAT_V 200, STAT_V 241 and 3rd or 4th year standing in Combined Major in Science

SCIE 320.title: Socio-Ecological Systems Research
SCIE 320.description: Research design and methods for socio-ecological systems research. Students work directly with faculty mentors to conduct research on contemporary topics such as climate resilience, food security, and environmental sustainability.

SCIE 400.title: Discipline-based Education Research Methodology
SCIE 400.description: Overview of methodological approaches to education research in disciplines having natural, physical, and life-science foundations.

prerequisite.raw: Third-year standing and permission of the instructor

SCIE 400.prerequisiteText: Third-year standing and permission of the instructor

SCIE 420.title: Sustainability for Community and the World
SCIE 420.description: Explores systems thinking in the context of sustainability and also re-examines the familiar three pillar model of sustainability - society, ecology, and economics - highlighting its uses and limitations.

children.raw: Fourth-year standing or permission of the instructor

SCIE 420.prerequisiteText: One of ASIC 200, ASIC 220, APBI 260, APBI 265, ARCL 309, BIOL 230, CHEM 301, CHEM 302, CHEM 341, CIVL 200, CONS 330, ECON 210, ENDS 221, ENVR 200, ENVR 300, EOSC 270, EOSC 340, EOSC 345, FRST 100, GEOG 211, GEOG 310, HIST 106, ISCI 360, ISCI 361, LAW 386, LFS 250, PHYS 333, POLI 351, PSYC 321, PSYC 421, SCIE 120, SCIE 320. Fourth-year standing or permission of the instructor

SCIE 466.title: New Venture Design
SCIE 466.description: Teams comprising students in SCIE_V 466 and COMM_V 466 create a business plan and a prototype or scientific solution of a novel product, process, or process component.
